passages.text: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria, you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy, who say to your husbands, “Bring us more to drink.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the women of Samaria.
These women live on Mount Samaria.
They are called the cows of Bashan.
They oppress the poor.
They crush the needy.
They say to their husbands, “Bring us more to drink.”
passages.original: שִׁמְע֞וּ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה פָּר֤וֹת הַבָּשָׁן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּהַ֣ר שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן הָעֹשְׁק֣וֹת דַּלִּ֔ים הָרֹצְצ֖וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים הָאֹמְרֹ֥ת לַאֲדֹֽנֵיהֶ֖ם הָבִ֥יאָה וְנִשְׁתֶּֽה׃

passages.text: The Lord GOD has sworn by His holiness: “Behold, the days are coming when you will be taken away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The Lord GOD is holy.
The Lord GOD makes a solemn promise.
He says, “Days are coming for you.
You will be taken away with hooks.
Your descendants will be taken away with fishhooks.”
passages.original: נִשְׁבַּ֨ע אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ בְּקָדְשׁ֔וֹ כִּ֛י הִנֵּ֥ה יָמִ֖ים בָּאִ֣ים עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְנִשָּׂ֤א אֶתְכֶם֙ בְּצִנּ֔וֹת וְאַחֲרִיתְכֶ֖ן בְּסִיר֥וֹת דּוּגָֽה׃

passages.text: You will go out through broken walls, each one straight ahead of her, and you will be cast out toward Harmon,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord speaks to the women of Samaria.
These women oppress the poor.
They crush the needy.
The Lord says what will happen to them.
You will go out through broken walls.
Each woman will go straight ahead of her.
You will be cast out toward Harmon.
The Lord has declared this.
passages.original: וּפְרָצִ֥ים תֵּצֶ֖אנָה אִשָּׁ֣ה נֶגְדָּ֑הּ וְהִשְׁלַכְתֶּ֥נָה הַהַרְמ֖וֹנָה נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “Go to Bethel and transgress; rebel even more at Gilgal! Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
He commands them to go to Bethel.
He tells them to sin there.
He commands them to go to Gilgal.
He tells them to increase their rebellion there.
He tells them to bring their sacrifices every morning.
He tells them to bring their tithes every three days.
passages.original: בֹּ֤אוּ בֵֽית־ אֵל֙ וּפִשְׁע֔וּ הַגִּלְגָּ֖ל הַרְבּ֣וּ לִפְשֹׁ֑עַ וְהָבִ֤יאוּ לַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ זִבְחֵיכֶ֔ם לִשְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים מַעְשְׂרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Offer leavened bread as a thank offering, and loudly proclaim your freewill offerings. For that is what you children of Israel love to do,” declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the children of Israel.
He says, "Offer leavened bread as a thank offering.
Proclaim your freewill offerings loudly.
You children of Israel love to do these things.
This is what the Lord GOD declares."
passages.original: וְקַטֵּ֤ר מֵֽחָמֵץ֙ תּוֹדָ֔ה וְקִרְא֥וּ נְדָב֖וֹת הַשְׁמִ֑יעוּ כִּ֣י כֵ֤ן אֲהַבְתֶּם֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: “I beset all your cities with cleanness of teeth and all your towns with lack of bread, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to the people of Israel.
The LORD gave them cleanness of teeth in all their cities.
This means the people had nothing to eat.
The LORD caused a lack of bread in all their towns.
The people still did not return to the LORD.
The LORD Himself declares this.
passages.original: וְגַם־ אֲנִי֩ נָתַ֨תִּי לָכֶ֜ם נִקְי֤וֹן שִׁנַּ֙יִם֙ בְּכָל־ עָ֣רֵיכֶ֔ם וְחֹ֣סֶר לֶ֔חֶם בְּכֹ֖ל מְקוֹמֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “I also withheld the rain from you when the harvest was three months away. I sent rain on one city but withheld it from another. One field received rain; another without rain withered.
passages.sermon:
The Lord God spoke to the people of Israel.
He withheld rain from them.
He did this when the harvest was still three months away.
He sent rain on one city.
He did not send rain on another city.
One field received rain.
Another field did not receive rain.
The field without rain dried up.
passages.original: וְגַ֣ם אָנֹכִי֩ מָנַ֨עְתִּי מִכֶּ֜ם אֶת־ הַגֶּ֗שֶׁם בְּע֨וֹד שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה חֳדָשִׁים֙ לַקָּצִ֔יר וְהִמְטַרְתִּי֙ עַל־ עִ֣יר אֶחָ֔ת וְעַל־ עִ֥יר אַחַ֖ת לֹ֣א אַמְטִ֑יר חֶלְקָ֤ה אַחַת֙ תִּמָּטֵ֔ר וְחֶלְקָ֛ה אֲשֶֽׁר־ לֹֽא־ תַמְטִ֥יר עָלֶ֖יהָ תִּיבָֽשׁ׃

passages.text: People staggered from city to city for water to drink, but they were not satisfied; yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to Israel.
The LORD says, “People traveled from city to city.
Two or three cities went to one city.
They went to find water to drink.
They did not find enough water.
They were not satisfied.
Yet you did not return to Me.”
This is the declaration of the LORD.
passages.original: וְנָע֡וּ שְׁתַּיִם֩ שָׁלֹ֨שׁ עָרִ֜ים אֶל־ עִ֥יר אַחַ֛ת לִשְׁתּ֥וֹת מַ֖יִם וְלֹ֣א יִשְׂבָּ֑עוּ וְלֹֽא־ שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “I struck you with blight and mildew in your growing gardens and vineyards; the locust devoured your fig and olive trees, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Israel.
The LORD punished Israel.
The LORD struck Israel with blight.
The LORD struck Israel with mildew.
The LORD sent these troubles on Israel’s gardens.
The LORD sent these troubles on Israel’s vineyards.
The locust ate Israel’s fig trees.
The locust ate Israel’s olive trees.
Israel did not return to the LORD.
The LORD declares this.
passages.original: הִכֵּ֣יתִי אֶתְכֶם֮ בַּשִּׁדָּפ֣וֹן וּבַיֵּרָקוֹן֒ הַרְבּ֨וֹת גַּנּוֹתֵיכֶ֧ם וְכַרְמֵיכֶ֛ם וּתְאֵנֵיכֶ֥ם וְזֵיתֵיכֶ֖ם יֹאכַ֣ל הַגָּזָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: “I sent plagues among you like those of Egypt; I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking to Israel.
The LORD sent plagues among the people.
These plagues were like those that struck Egypt.
The LORD killed the young men of Israel with the sword.
The LORD also killed their captured horses.
The LORD filled the people’s nostrils with the stench from their camp.
The people did not return to the LORD.
The LORD declares these things.
passages.original: שִׁלַּ֨חְתִּי בָכֶ֥ם דֶּ֙בֶר֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם הָרַ֤גְתִּי בַחֶ֙רֶב֙ בַּח֣וּרֵיכֶ֔ם עִ֖ם שְׁבִ֣י סֽוּסֵיכֶ֑ם וָאַעֲלֶ֞ה בְּאֹ֤שׁ מַחֲנֵיכֶם֙ וּֽבְאַפְּכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “Some of you I overthrew as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a firebrand snatched from a blaze, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking to Israel.
The LORD has great power and authority.
The LORD overthrew some of the people of Israel.
The LORD did this as He once overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
Sodom and Gomorrah were destroyed by God because of their sin.
Some people of Israel survived, but only barely.
They were like a burning stick pulled out of a fire.
Even after this, the people did not return to the LORD.
The LORD Himself declares this.
passages.original: הָפַ֣כְתִּי בָכֶ֗ם כְּמַהְפֵּכַ֤ת אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ סְדֹ֣ם וְאֶת־ עֲמֹרָ֔ה וַתִּהְי֕וּ כְּא֖וּד מֻצָּ֣ל מִשְׂרֵפָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: “Therefore, that is what I will do to you, O Israel, and since I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, O Israel!
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God says, “I will act against you, Israel.
I will do these things to you.
Because I will do this, get ready.
Prepare to meet your God, Israel.”
passages.original: לָכֵ֕ן כֹּ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֖ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֵ֚קֶב כִּֽי־ זֹ֣את אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לָּ֔ךְ הִכּ֥וֹן לִקְרַאת־ אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: For behold, He who forms the mountains, who creates the wind and reveals His thoughts to man, who turns the dawn to darkness and strides on the heights of the earth— the LORD, the God of Hosts, is His name.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Hosts.
He forms the mountains.
He creates the wind.
He reveals His thoughts to man.
He turns the dawn into darkness.
He walks on the heights of the earth.
His name is the LORD, the God of Hosts.
passages.original: כִּ֡י הִנֵּה֩ יוֹצֵ֨ר הָרִ֜ים וּבֹרֵ֣א ר֗וּחַ וּמַגִּ֤יד לְאָדָם֙ מַה־ שֵּׂח֔וֹ עֹשֵׂ֥ה שַׁ֙חַר֙ עֵיפָ֔ה וְדֹרֵ֖ךְ עַל־ בָּ֣מֳתֵי אָ֑רֶץ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס
